info.name: geneav — Scan API
info.description:
Document malware scanning.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to https://geneav.com for production, or http://localhost:8080 when running the local docker stack.

Every request except Sign up and Health needs an API key. Run "Sign up" once, copy the `apiKey` from the response into the `apiKey` collection variable, and the rest of the collection authenticates automatically.

Interactive docs: https://geneav.com/docs

variable.description: API origin. Use http://localhost:8080 against the local stack.
A gav_live_... key from the dashboard or from Sign up. Required on every request except Sign up and Health — there is no anonymous tier.

item.name: Sign up (get your first API key)

request.description:
Creates an account and returns its first API key. The plaintext key is shown ONCE, in this response — copy it into the `apiKey` collection variable.

One of the few endpoints that needs no key, for the obvious reason.

Uploads one document and returns a clean/infected verdict, authenticated with your API key so the scan counts against the account's monthly plan quota.

The `file` form field MUST have its type set to File. Do not add a Content-Type header by hand — Postman generates the multipart boundary, and overriding it drops the boundary and breaks the request.

Usage is recorded only after a scan succeeds — failed scans are not billed.

Limits: 25 MB per file; rate limited per plan.

Responses: 200 completed, 400 missing/empty file, 401 missing/invalid key, 402 quota exhausted (free plan = 500 scans/month), 413 too large, 415 unsupported type, 429 rate limited, 503 scan engine down.
Current-month scan usage against the plan quota for the key's account.

Reports whether the API and the ClamAV engine are ready. Returns status UP, or DEGRADED when the engine is unreachable.

Public: no key, so uptime monitors can reach it.
